sources.title: Distributing your app for beta testing and releases
supported_claims: TestFlight distribution requires Apple Developer Program membership.
Create an archive and select a distribution method; Xcode offers validation and automatic signing.
TestFlight Internal Only restricts the build to the team; the ordinary TestFlight and App Store method supports broader distribution.

sources.title: Add a new app
supported_claims: An app record is required before uploading.
Creation requires Account Holder, Admin, or App Manager role and accepted current agreement.
The app record includes platform, name, primary language, bundle ID and SKU.

sources.title: Upload builds
supported_claims: Uploads require Account Holder, Admin, App Manager, or Developer role.
Bundle ID and version associate the upload with the app; build string uniquely identifies the build.
Processing must finish before the uploaded build appears.

sources.title: TestFlight overview
supported_claims: Provide test information and a feedback email; review export-compliance requirements.
Assign an uploaded build to an internal or external tester group.
The first external build needs App Review approval; subsequent builds may not require full review.
